name: Cardamom Coffee
steps: Lightly crush the cardamom pods. Measure the milk, water and coffee.
Warm the milk with cardamom over low heat for 4–5 minutes, stirring occasionally; do not let it boil over.
Dissolve instant coffee and sugar in the hot measured water in a heatproof jug.
Strain the spiced milk into the coffee and stir well.
Taste, divide between four mugs and serve immediately. Reduce sugar for a less sweet drink.
tips: Serve freshly prepared. Adjust sweetness after tasting.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
